sentences.zh: 我在那儿站了一整天，和每一个买巨型骷髅或试图买巨型骷髅的人聊天。

sentences.en: I was there in September.
sentences.zh: 我是九月份去的。

sentences.en: Some of the people I talked to had been looking, like, since July.
sentences.zh: 我聊过的一些人，甚至从七月份就开始找了。

sentences.en: One woman that I interviewed who got a skeleton that day, it all worked out.
sentences.zh: 我采访过的一位女士那天买到了骷髅，总算如愿以偿。

sentences.en: But she said she'd visited 15 Home Depots or so and had called about 50 trying to get her hands on one.
sentences.zh: 但她说为了买到一个，她去了大概15家家得宝，打了差不多50个电话。

sentences.en: I wrote the story in 2022.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年写了这篇报道。

sentences.en: Consumer spending on Halloween that year was $10.6 billion.
sentences.zh: 当年消费者在万圣节上的支出是106亿美元。

sentences.en: It's continued going up.
sentences.zh: 这个数字还在不断攀升。

sentences.en: This year, it's projected to be $13.5 billion.
sentences.zh: 今年预计将达到135亿美元。

sentences.en: Why do you think that is?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: The highest ever for Americans.
sentences.zh: 创下了美国历史新高。

sentences.en: Those numbers are from the National Retail Federation, I should say.
sentences.zh: 我得说明一下，这些数据来自全美零售联合会。

sentences.en: Halloween, I think a lot of retailers have seized on.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多零售商都抓住了万圣节商机。

sentences.en: It's not a blue state or a red state thing.
sentences.zh: 这可不是什么蓝州或红州的问题。

sentences.en: It is not celebrated as a religious holiday.
sentences.zh: 它不被当作宗教节日来庆祝。

sentences.en: It is not known for people getting into arguments like Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 它不像感恩节那样容易引发争吵。

sentences.en: It doesn't involve a bunch of stressful travel like some of the winter holidays.
sentences.zh: 它不像某些冬季节日那样需要经历压力重重的旅行。

sentences.en: I think it's seen as this holiday that comes with a lot less baggage, I think, than some others.
sentences.zh: 我认为比起其他节日，它被视为一个包袱少得多的节日。

sentences.en: Retailers have sort of seized upon that.
sentences.zh: 零售商们正是抓住了这一点。

sentences.en: And it's an opportunity for those retailers to sell things.
sentences.zh: 这对这些零售商来说是个卖货的好机会。

sentences.en: But it's also an opportunity, I think, for the people who like celebrating it to use their imaginations a little bit, which other holidays don't entirely allow you to do.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，对于喜欢庆祝它的人来说，这也是一个稍微发挥想象力的机会，而其他节日并不完全允许你这样做。

sentences.en: And I think Skelly has been a little bit of a canvas for that imagination that people have going on.
sentences.zh: 我觉得斯克利就像是人们发挥这种想象力的画布。

sentences.en: Welcome back to part three of me turning my Home Depot 12-foot skeleton into an alien for our Area 51 theme this year for our Halloween yard.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到我把家得宝12英尺骷髅变成外星人的第三期节目，今年我们万圣节庭院的主题是51区。

sentences.en: I'm wondering, before we wrap up, I'm curious if there have been any advances in Skelly science since Skelly came out.
sentences.zh: 在结束之前，我想问一下，自从斯克利问世以来，骷髅科技有什么新进展吗？

sentences.en: I've been closely monitoring advancements in skeleton technology since 2022.
sentences.zh: 我从2022年起就一直在密切关注骷髅科技的进展。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Last week, I chatted with Aubrey Horowitz, who's the Merchant of Decorative Holiday at Home Depot.
sentences.zh: 上周，我采访了奥布里·霍洛维茨（Aubrey Horowitz），她是家得宝的节日装饰品采购经理（Merchant of Decorative Holiday）。

sentences.en: She's someone who—
sentences.zh: 她是一个——

sentences.en: She's the what?
sentences.zh: 她是什么？

sentences.en: The Merchant of Decorative Holiday.
sentences.zh: 节日装饰品采购经理。

sentences.en: That's her actual title.
sentences.zh: 这是她的真实头衔。

sentences.en: That is her job title.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的工作头衔。

sentences.en: Wow, that's a great title.
sentences.zh: 哇，这头衔真棒。

sentences.en: But she said Home Depot has been, like, thinking really hard about what do you do when you have this thing that's kind of a viral sensation for a year or two?
sentences.zh: 但她说家得宝一直在认真思考，当你拥有这样一个火了一两年的现象级爆款时，你该怎么办？

sentences.en: How do you keep that momentum up?
sentences.zh: 你该如何保持这种势头？

sentences.en: I was really curious about that.
sentences.zh: 我对这个真的很感兴趣。

sentences.en: We introduced—we called him Servo Skelly a few years ago, and he had a servo motor in his head that allowed him to move.
sentences.zh: 我们几年前推出了——我们叫他“伺服斯克利”（Servo Skelly），他的头部有一个伺服马达，可以让他动起来。

sentences.en: And then this year, our new app, Skelly, is Bluetooth-enabled, where customers can update his lighting, his movement.
sentences.zh: 然后今年，我们的新版应用斯克利支持蓝牙功能，顾客可以更新他的灯光、动作。

sentences.en: They can change his different eye functionality, pre-record messages, or speak him to him live.
sentences.zh: 他们可以改变他不同的眼睛功能、预录留言，或者与他实时对话。

sentences.en: They've been making rapid advancements in skeleton technology.
sentences.zh: 他们在骷髅科技上取得了飞速的进步。

sentences.en: This year's 12-foot skeleton, you can live speak through Skelly.
sentences.zh: 今年的12英尺骷髅，你可以通过斯克利进行实时对话。

sentences.en: So if someone walks up in a pirate costume, you could make a sort of, like, ahoy, matey-type pirate observation.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有人穿着海盗服装走过来，你可以说出类似“哟吼，船长”的海盗式打招呼。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess that could be really cute, but I could also imagine many, many tiny children being totally terrified by this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来可能很可爱，但我也能想象会有许许多多的小朋友被这个吓得魂飞魄散。

sentences.en: And happy Halloween.
sentences.zh: 万圣节快乐。

sentences.en: That's the point, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点，雷切尔。

sentences.en: Beware.
sentences.zh: 小心点。

sentences.en: He will spot you the moment you step too close.
sentences.zh: 你只要走得太近，他一眼就能发现你。

sentences.en: Behave, my tiny mortals.
sentences.zh: 给我老实点，我小小的人类凡们。

sentences.en: I'm always watching.
sentences.zh: 我一直在看着你们。

sentences.en: I really appreciate knowing so much more about this 12-foot skeleton—I'm sorry, 11-foot, 8-inch skeleton.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢能让我对这个12英尺的骷髅——对不起，是11英尺8英寸的骷髅有更多的了解。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, Callie Holderman, I am the Merchant of Holiday Podcasts, and I want to thank you for being here with us today.
sentences.zh: 好吧，卡莉·霍尔德曼（Calli Holderman），我是假日播客采购经理，非常感谢你今天来到我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Happy Halloween.
sentences.zh: 万圣节快乐。

sentences.en: Happy Halloween.
sentences.zh: 万圣节快乐。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《周日日报》（Sunday Daily）的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是雷切尔·亚伯拉姆斯（Rachel Abrams）。明天见。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一关灯就能秒睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才睡着的。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
